cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Delegate Downward
cards.instruction: Make someone accept an unwanted responsibility by placing them lower in the hierarchy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. You're my deputy. You'll answer the inspector's complaints.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Most of them concern decisions you made.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Exactly. You handle the details below decision-making level.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The inspector wants whoever signs the replies at tomorrow's hearing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sign as deputy, then. You can represent me without giving the impression we're equals.

mechanism: A applies precise job-scope and signature corrections to make a deputy absorb complaints and hearing attendance about A decisions.
confusable: Avoid confusing with D49 ordinary help: B is assigned unwanted accountability specifically because their role is lower.
comparison: Sink alternative uses a promotion to add maintenance duties; inspector alternative separates executive decisions from subordinate complaint handling.
seedUse: Inspector complaints, decision level and signed replies derive from D53-b; S03 adds document scope and title-placement directions.
